notes: The loss run summary begins on page 1, while the individual claim detail table begins on page 2. The page 2 header repeats the document header and detail-column labels. Each claim is presented as a multiline row: policy number, claim reference number, claim/occurrence number, and claimant number are stacked; policy term, policy type, claim status, claim type, loss date, loss location, reported date, and close date are also arranged in paired multiline fields. Claimant Name, Loss Description, and Writing Company appear beneath each claim row. A policy-level summary Total Incurred is shown on page 1 and should not be confused with the individual claim-row Total Incurred.
